_meta.note: Walking-logic extracted from TibiaWiki 'Mainland Trails' text + annotated overland map (Free_account_routes.png). Tibia 7.4 vanilla; verify on Rivalia. This is a NETWORK overview, not a single point-to-point route: the map shows the whole free-account overland trail spine plus boat links.
_meta.coord_system: Tibia game coords. z = floor (7=ground surface). All overland trails are surface (z=7).
_meta.legend: steps[] enumerates the trail segments and travel links visible on the map. heading = cardinal direction of travel along that leg. action walk = on-foot overland trail; board-boat = water crossing (no land path).

start.note: No single start — network overview. Thais is the southern hub, Kazordoon the central hub, Carlin the northern hub.

min_level_note: Text: mid-low levels can travel if they stay on the paths. Off-path hazards escalate (Dragon at Venore lair, Orc Berserker/Leader near Orc Fortress).
advice: Stay ON the paths except Thais–Venore and Kazordoon–Carlin (those two legs are safe enough to leave the road).
Always carry a Rope and a Shovel — needed for holes/ladders and blocked spots.

steps.heading: hub
steps.text: Thais (south) is the main southern hub. Yellow lines = walkable overland trails; red lines = boat-only water routes; cyan = short boat/ferry hops.

steps.heading: NW
steps.text: Thais → Greenshore: short trail NW out of Thais up the west coast to Greenshore.

steps.heading: N
steps.text: Thais → Kazordoon: trail runs N/NE from Thais up to the central Kazordoon mountain hub. Passes the sand/desert belt.

steps.heading: E then NE
steps.text: Thais → Venore: long trail E then NE toward Venore, skirting the Outlaw Camp. Text marks this as one of the two legs where leaving the road is tolerable.

steps.heading: SE
steps.text: Thais → Outlaw Camp / Dark Cathedral: trail branches SE toward the Outlaw Camp and Dark Cathedral in the southern peninsula.

steps.heading: N
steps.text: Kazordoon → Carlin: trail N from the Kazordoon hub to Carlin. Second leg text says is safe enough to leave the road.

steps.heading: NE
steps.text: Kazordoon → Ab'Dendriel: trail NE from Kazordoon to the elf city Ab'Dendriel.

steps.heading: N
steps.text: Carlin → Northport: trail N up to Northport on the north coast.

steps.heading: E
steps.text: Ab'Dendriel → Orc Fortress: trail E into orc territory toward the Orc Fortress.

steps.heading: E
steps.text: Venore → Amazon Camp: short trail E from Venore to the Amazon Camp.

steps.heading: SE
steps.text: Venore → Shadowthorn: trail SE/E from Venore toward Shadowthorn (elf/orc frontier). Venore Dragon Lair is off this leg — Dragon hazard.

steps.heading: SW
steps.text: Thais → Fibula: cyan hop — short boat/ferry crossing SW to Fibula island. No land path.

steps.heading: central
steps.text: Kazordoon (A) ↔ Kazordoon (B): cyan link across the mountain — the two Kazordoon access points are joined by an internal passage/hop, not a straight surface walk.

steps.heading: W
steps.text: Carlin/Ghostlands → Isle of the Kings → Vega → Senja → Folda: RED boat route — the entire NW archipelago (Folda, Senja, Vega, Ghostlands, Isle of the Kings) is reachable only by boat, no overland trail.
